reason: Room: the candidate grows bank 4's renderer by 9 bytes (new .next 20 bytes for 3; cold code 14 for 22: +17 -8), and the DEBUG_FULLREDRAW build - the oracle twin the proofs (passlock, worldrun --control, kcguard, scrollleft) compare against - no longer assembles: built in a scratch worktree with the candidate applied, `make DEFINES=DEBUG_FULLREDRAW` and `DEFINES=DEBUG_FULLREDRAW,DEBUG_LIVES` fail with 'src/main.6502:151:5: error: bank 4 overruns the renderer's workspace by 2', while the same builds at HEAD 9f97ad5 assemble. (The shipping, SKY_HELI=0 and a GAMEPLAY_SHIELD,GAMEPLAY_LIVES build still assemble.) The semantics otherwise check out: b_ptr is &C9/&CA (renderer scratch, zero page, unaffected by ACCCON/ROMSEL); its high byte comes from raise_address/movers_screen_address_high, which the game's add/subtract routines and the renderer ring into &40-&7F, so DEC+TSB #&40 and INC/BPL/LSR give the old values; A and flags are dead at each; no other references to forward_in_ring/back_in_ring/next_c entries. But it does not fit the free space of every maintained flag set, so it is refuted (a smaller variant without the inlined .next, i.e. the cold-code-only alternative which saves bytes, would not hit this).
